title: Global Travel Policy
content: Employees may book economy airfare. Manager approval is required for trips over $2,000. Expense reports are due within 30 days.

title: Vacation Accrual Policy
content: Full-time employees accrue 15 vacation days per year. Up to 5 unused days carry over. Balances are updated after each pay period.

title: Vacation Accrual Policy
content: Full-time employees accrue 12 vacation days per year. Up to 3 unused days carry over. Balances are updated monthly.
